subject: MAP draft: vendor onboarding & procurement setup — Hearthstone Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: vendor onboarding & procurement setup — Hearthstone Health

Hi Kate —

Nice to meet you on the call earlier. As promised, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so your procurement and vendor-enablement teams have a clear path to production once the commercial terms are complete. Attachment: Hearthstone_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

TL;DR proposed milestones for onboarding/procurement:
- Vendor paperwork submitted (W-9 + vendor packet) — Owner: Hearthstone procurement — Target: 2026-02-26
- Vendor profile created in Ariba/Coupa (platform selection TBD) — Owner: Hearthstone procurement + Redwood (support) — Target: 2026-03-03
- Banking details & ACH setup (test transaction) — Owner: Hearthstone finance & bank — Target: 2026-03-05
- Production permit & SLA deployment (post-ONBOARD) — Owner: Redwood Ops + Hearthstone IT — Target: 2026-03-12

Dependencies and open items we flagged on the call:
1) Confirm whether you will onboard Redwood via Ariba or Coupa (procurement asked about preferred file / form).
2) Your vendor paperwork template — if you require a specific W-9 format or vendor packet fields, pls share.
3) Banking format (ACH vs wire) and sample bank form if you need one from us.

Requested next steps:
- Can you confirm procurement contact (name + email) we should send the vendor packet to?
- If the timeline above looks reasonable, reply with any date changes and we'll lock them into the MAP and send an updated xlsx.

I'll follow up with a short vendor packet (Redwood_Vendor_Info.pdf) and a sample W-9 in case your team wants to pre-populate. Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Subject: Re: MAP draft: vendor onboarding & procurement setup — Hearthstone Health

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the draft and the clear milestones. Quick answers from procurement below:

- We are using Coupa internally for vendor onboarding; we will need a vendor packet that includes a legal entity name, tax ID (EIN), mailing address for vendor payments, and bank details for ACH.
- Procurement will also need a signed W-9 from Redwood. I've attached a scanned copy of our vendor checklist for reference. (Attachment: Hearthstone_W9_Scan.pdf)
- Point of contact is me (kate.li@hearthstone.com) and our vendor specialist, Marcos Rivera (marcos.rivera@hearthstone.com). Please send the packet to both.

Couple of questions: can Redwood accept standard Coupa onboarding CSV export for bulk field mapping? Also, for ACH we often require a pre-note/test transaction — will Redwood be able to accept a $0.01 pre-note or 1-cent test? 

If you can send over the vendor packet and a sample W-9 we will start the Coupa entry this week.

Kate Li
Head of Procurement — Hearthstone Health
kate.li@hearthstone.com

Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: vendor onboarding & procurement setup — Hearthstone Health

Kate / Marcos —

Thanks for the quick reply and the Coupa confirmation. Short answers:
- Yes — we can accept Coupa's standard CSV export for onboarding. Our onboarding team will map fields from the CSV to our vendor system; if you export the CSV and attach it we’ll do a pre-check before you submit in Coupa.
- ACH pre-note: yes, we can accept a 1-cent test. Finance prefers ACH with pre-note; wire is also available but typically incurs fees.
- Attached: Redwood_Vendor_Info.pdf (vendor packet with legal entity + tax ID + address) and a sample unsigned W-9 for your records. We will provide a signed W-9 once procurement confirms the required signature flow (e-sign vs wet).

Updated MAP actions (I updated the spreadsheet and will push a revised copy to the shared Drive):
- Oak (#1) Vendor paperwork submitted — Owner: Hearthstone procurement — New target: 2026-02-27 (accounting for Coupa entry)
- Oak (#2) Coupa vendor profile created + CSV mapping completed — Owner: Hearthstone procurement + Redwood onboarding — Target: 2026-03-03
- Oak (#3) ACH pre-note processed — Owner: Hearthstone finance + Redwood finance — Target: 2026-03-05
- Oak (#4) Prod deployment & ping to SRE — Owner: Redwood ops + Hearthstone IT — Target: 2026-03-12

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Info.pdf (PDF), Redwood_W9_Sample.pdf (PDF)

Next actions for my side:
1) I'll upload the revised MAP to the Drive link and send a HubSpot update to reflect dates.
2) Marissa will coordinate onboarding schedule with our ops team after the Coupa profile is live.
3) Rishi will own commercial close checks (deal pin/funding) and verify billing terms.

Let me know if you'd like a short 15-min call to walk through the Coupa CSV mapping this week — happy to do that.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
